## Summary

PRD-pipeline durability hardening. Closes the three reflect follow-ups (F2/F4/F5) from a Tier-2 deep `/sc:reflect` audit of the document-capture two-atom crash fix, plus the Atom-1 `is_hard_failure`/`halt_reason` plumbing they depend on.

- **F2 — typed malformed-artifact guard** (`prompts.py`): adds `MalformedArtifactError(MissingArtifactError)`; `_load_json_required` now wraps the parse in `try/except json.JSONDecodeError`, so a present-but-corrupt required artifact converts to the existing graceful HALT (subclass-caught at the executor `_build_prompt` call site) instead of an uncaught `json.JSONDecodeError` escaping `run()`. Executor verb-derivation tweak so the HALT reads "malformed" (not "missing") for a present-but-corrupt file.
- **F4 — consistency-guard test** (`test_prompts.py`): pins the inline REQUIRED-read `(producer_step, filename)` pairs to `executor._STEP_ARTIFACT_FILES` (in-test import only — no circular-import coupling). Complements, does not duplicate, `test_prompt_executor_mapping_sync`.
- **F5 — strengthened assertion** (`test_e2e.py`): `test_e2e_standard_tier_validation_fail_does_not_halt` now asserts scope-discovery's recorded status `== PrdStepStatus.VALIDATION_FAIL` (real enum symbol), so it can no longer pass for the wrong reason.
- **Prerequisite** (`models.py`): `PrdStepStatus.is_hard_failure` property + `PrdStepResult.halt_reason` field (Atom-1 plumbing consumed by the executor HALT loop).

## Validation

- `uv run ruff check` clean on all edited files
- `uv run pytest tests/cli/prd/` → **160 passed**, 0 skip/xfail, **0 regression** (baseline 158 + F2 test + F4 test; F5 strengthened in place)

## Audit provenance

Verified by `/sc:reflect --mode post --depth deep` — Tier 2, 3 heterogeneous reviewers (root-cause / quality / refactoring) converged SOUND, evidence-validator re-Read gate, verification triangle. Deviation taxonomy: **0 drift / 0 regression**. One non-blocking advisory: the F4 test pins a frozen transcription dict (catches executor-side drift; a prompts.py-side filename edit needs lockstep test maintenance).

Note: the diff also carries the work-unit's task-tracking artifacts under `.dev/tasks/done/TASK-RF-20260608-144157/` (research notes, QA reports, test logs) for provenance.
